title: Rights of the Accused
description: This volume focuses on the constitutional doctrine and law in the areas of criminal rights. It contains excerpts of landmark cases covering the fourth, fifth, sixth, and eighth amendments, exceptions to the Warrants Rule, and investigatory methods. The excerpts include the constitutional issues in these cases that are related to rights of the accused with other questions of law and dicta omitted.
authors: Rorie Spill Solberg - Editor / Andrew Hoekman - Author / Katherine McKenna - Author / Charlotte Pietrzak - Author / Fox Perez - Author / Makenna Perry - Author / Jacob Staab - Author / Sloan Harmel - Author / Alex Nobiletti - Author / Sobhi Sidani - Author
